entry.name: mc.gradient~
entry.digest: Generate a time-varying function over the space of a multichannel signal
entry.description: Add breakpoints to the mc.gradient~ to specify a function where both the domain and range go from 0 to 1. The output range is mapped across the space of a multichannel signal. Connect a phasor~ or another time-varying single- or multichannel signal to the mc.gradient~ object to drive its output.

arguments.name: chans
arguments.description: Change the number of channels in the output multichannel signal. The output channel count will not change until the audio is restarted. The default value of theattribute is 0 meaning the object's argument determines the number of output channels.

attributes.name: mode
attributes.digest: Oscillation Mode
attributes.description: Determines the direction of oscillation over the functions domain. Options are up, down, and up/down. Currently only up mode is supported.

choices.label: Oscillation values in the Y-range increase over the functions domain.
Oscillation values in the Y-range decrease over the functions domain (not currently supported).

messages.name: chanval
messages.digest: Value of channel at input position
messages.description: Returns the value of the output function for a given channel and input position.

messages.name: clear
messages.digest: Removes all breakpoints in the function
messages.description: Themessage removes all breakpoints in the current function, restoring it to the default state.

messages.name: float
messages.description: Return the function values for each channel at the specified x-position in the range 0.0 - 1.0.

messages.name: list
messages.description: Themessage adds a new breakpoint. Up to 4 values can be used to specify the x postion, upper y value, lower y value, and phase offset of the breakpoint. If the list contains two values, it creates a breakpoint with a fixed y value at the x postion. An optional third value specifies the lower y value range and a fourth value can be used to specify the phase value (default 0.). If the supplied x value matches an existing breakpoint, that breakpoint will be modified.

messages.name: printfunction
messages.digest: Print the function to the Max console.
messages.description: Themessage prints the current function to the console.

messages.name: signal
messages.description: A single channel signal controls all breakpoints. A multichannel signal maps each channel to a separate breakpoint as they are ordered from left to right, wrapping if the number of input channels is greater than the number of breakpoints.
